segment_definition: continuous phase + packed-band/offroad; packed band uses road.Distance < road.HalfWidth + 0.6m, actual audio surface is recorded separately

timing_notes.frame_ms: monotonic Time.GetTicksUsec delta between ProcessPriority=100 samples; drawn frame counters accompany it
timing_notes.process_physics_ms: Godot Performance monitors sampled after default-priority game/audio callbacks
timing_notes.movement: XZ displacement and cumulative path are measured between later-priority Process samples; each step event summarizes the interval since the previous event. Same-segment intervals >= 500 ms also include their per-frame movement/gate trace. Gate counts observe public actor state matching FootstepAudioController reset checks; the controller's private accumulator/reset calls are not exposed.
timing_notes.snow: update/redraw/mesh timings are included only on frames where snowTrampleStampCount advanced; a multi-stamp frame reports the stamp delta and latest timing once
timing_notes.playback: Playing/HasStreamPlayback/GetPlaybackPosition describe the single AudioStreamPlayer; internal polyphonic voice count is unavailable
timing_notes.surface: LastSurface is the last surface resolved by an actual step; trigger events carry its fresh value, while per-frame fields can carry it forward between steps
timing_notes.data_only: capture status is not a diagnosis or task acceptance
